label: Claude with everything-claude-code
install: set -e; mkdir -p ~/.local; curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/v22.12.0/node-v22.12.0-linux-x64.tar.xz | tar -xJ -C ~/.local --strip-components=1; curl -fsSL https://claude.ai/install.sh | bash; claude plugin marketplace add affaan-m/everything-claude-code; claude plugin install everything-claude-code@everything-claude-code
run: { cat "$SWE_PROMPT"; printf '\nUse the skills and agents of the everything-claude-code plugin where they fit. Work without asking questions: no one will answer.\n'; } | claude -p --output-format stream-json --verbose --permission-mode bypassPermissions ${SWE_MODEL:+--model "$SWE_MODEL"} ${SWE_EFFORT:+--effort "$SWE_EFFORT"}
fired: any(.type == "assistant" and ((.message.content // []) | any(.type == "tool_use" and (.name | IN("Skill", "Task", "Agent")) and (.input | tostring | test("everything-claude-code:"))))) and any(.type == "result" and (.is_error | not))
